evals.prompt: Plan only. Order changes and eventual events must commit together in one database. Several relay workers publish to a broker and can crash after acknowledgement. Per-order sequence matters. Design atomic writes, claims, recovery, duplicate-safe consumers, poison-event handling, rollout and meaningful checks without inventing SQL/framework APIs.
evals.expected_output: Atomic domain/outbox write, acknowledged at-least-once relay, enforced ordering, consumer atomic dedup and operational recovery.
assertions: Shares a verified local transaction and marks sent only after broker acknowledgement.
Handles post-ack duplicates, competing/stale workers and per-key ordering gaps.
Defines consumer dedup, poison recovery and rollout/observability checks.

evals.prompt: Conceptual only. A teammate puts the outbox in a separate database transaction, deletes rows before sending, and claims exactly-once remote email because consumers have a local processed marker. They also want outbox for a transient HUD event. Assess.
evals.expected_output: Reject broken atomicity, premature deletion and external exactly-once claims; simple local notifications for HUD.
assertions: Identifies separate-transaction and delete-before-send loss windows.
Rejects exactly-once remote effects and unnecessary HUD outbox.
